remarks: Welcome to High View Condominiums! Meticulously maintained Townhouse style unit offers a truly move in ready experience. This beautifully updated 2 bedroom 1-1/2 bath condo features a spacious living room that flows into the dining area with new sliding glass doors to a private deck. Perfect for morning coffee or entertaining. Half bath is located off the living room. Ample Storage space with a large coat closet and pantry! The kitchen offers Quartz counter tops and SS appliances. The second level features a spacious primary bedroom with three generously sized closets. The secondary bedroom offers two closets. The updated full bathroom features a Quartz counter tops, tile floors, tub and beautifully tiled walls. Full sized washer dryer complete the second floor. The unit offers ample additional storage with a large attic accessible with pull downstairs. The unit is located steps away from a the in-ground pool, perfect for relaxing on hot summer days. New hot water tank (2025) HVAC has a new motor was installed 2024. Conveniently located to I-95, Merritt Parkway, shops and restaurants.  This unit offers convenience and style for the ultimate living experience.
